content:
The data processing pipeline successfully audited service queue SLAs and generated the required Excel and Word reports.
The executor used openpyxl and pandas to transform source data into an 8-column 'Formatted Data' sheet, including a 'Grand Total' row with a '-' placeholder in the Region column. Logic correctly identified 'Missing Escalation' flags by handling NaN values and built an 'Error Summary' string covering four distinct states. The final Word document was verified to contain 3-6 sentences incorporating specific data points from the audit results.
